assertions.title: Sentry gracefully degrades when DSN absent

steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:5173/ in the assigned browser session
steps.expected: App stays up with blank Sentry DSN and shows its expected unauthenticated redirect or landing state without a blank screen
steps.observed: The app stayed up and redirected to http://localhost:5173/sign-in, showing the sign-in form with Email, Password, Sign in, and Create one controls.

steps.expected: Sign-in UI renders without a blank screen or uncaught exception when VITE_SENTRY_DSN is blank
steps.observed: The sign-in surface rendered successfully and remained interactive, but the browser console logged a React hydration mismatch error.

steps.action: Inspect browser network activity during /sign-in load
steps.expected: No Sentry ingest traffic when the frontend DSN override is blank
steps.observed: The page loaded @sentry/react-router assets and sent POST requests to https://o4511032814534656.ingest.de.sentry.io/api/4511036982100048/envelope/, indicating frontend Sentry traffic still occurred.

steps.expected: Server responds successfully while SENTRY_DSN_SERVER is blank
steps.observed: The endpoint returned HTTP 200 OK with body {"status":"ok","timestamp":"2026-03-14T18:10:58.740Z"}.

evidence.consoleErrors: On /sign-in reload, console logged a React hydration mismatch error on <html> attributes (dark theme/className/style mismatch). An earlier / navigation also logged 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: http://localhost:5173/src/entry.client.tsx' plus 504 'Outdated Optimize Dep' resource errors before the sign-in page recovered.
evidence.network: Frontend navigation redirected / -> /sign-in and loaded Clerk assets. Browser network log also captured POST requests to Sentry ingest (o4511032814534656.ingest.de.sentry.io) despite the blank frontend DSN override. Server health check: GET /api/health -> 200 OK.

assertions.issues: The app did not blank-screen, and server health stayed green, but the frontend still emitted Sentry envelope requests and logged console errors while the test environment was supposed to have blank Sentry DSN overrides.

summary: Tested 1 assertion (VAL-FOUND-009). Result: fail. The unauthenticated UI remained reachable and /api/health returned 200, but the frontend still sent Sentry ingest requests and logged console errors under the blank-DSN test setup.
